definition: I. עֲרוֺעֵר noun [masculine] probably a tree or bush; juniper ? (Arabic juniper (or cypress ? see Lane ), so Tristr NHB 358 Rob BR ii. 124 ; on formative see Lag BN 162 Ba NB 160 ); — עֲרוֺעֵר בַּמִּדְבָּר Jer 48:6 , + Jer 17:6 , where read probably עֲרֹעֵר בָּעֲרָבָה (for ᵑ0 עַרְעָר ; > Gf and others conversely, read עַרְעָר Jer 48:6 ).
